step1_analysis.description: A fully differential amplifier with capacitive feedback. In the context of the paper, this represents a continuous-time equivalent or a specific charge-transfer phase of a switched-capacitor resonator used in a bandpass sigma-delta ADC.

paper_reference.title: A 80-MHz Bandpass Sigma-Delta Modulator for a 100-MHz IF Receiver

midband_gain.description: Closed-loop AC voltage gain in the passband

sky130_expected.reasoning: The closed-loop gain is strictly determined by the ratio of the input capacitor (CiA) to the feedback capacitor (CiB).

sky130_expected.calculation: Depends on the op-amp's Gain-Bandwidth Product (GBW). Modeled here with a ~53 MHz closed-loop BW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: In a real SC circuit sampled at 80MHz, the closed-loop bandwidth must be at least 5x the sampling frequency for proper settling. Here, it is determined by the behavioral op-amp model's dominant pole.

transient_swing.description: Maximum peak-to-peak single-ended output voltage swing

sky130_expected.reasoning: Linear transient response based on the closed-loop gain of 2.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for the differential capacitive amplifier measuring closed-loop gain, bandwidth, and transient swing. A behavioral op-amp model is used since transistor-level details were not provided. High-value resistors are added to prevent floating virtual grounds.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Differential Capacitive Amplifier Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param CiA=2p CiB=1p

* DUT (Note: Changed A1 to X1 for standard SPICE subcircuit instantiation)
X1 IN- IN+ OP OM amplifier
C2 IN- OP {CiB}
C1 IN+ OM {CiB}
C4 IN- IN1 {CiA}
C3 IN+ IN2 {CiA}

* DC bias resistors to prevent floating nodes (virtual grounds)
Rbias1 IN- OP 1G
Rbias2 IN+ OM 1G

* Behavioral Amplifier Model
.subckt amplifier inn inp outp outn
B1 outp_ideal 0 V=0.9 + 1000*(V(inp)-V(inn))
B2 outn_ideal 0 V=0.9 - 1000*(V(inp)-V(inn))
R1 outp_ideal outp 1k
C1 outp 0 1n
R2 outn_ideal outn 1k
C2 outn 0 1n
.ends

* Stimulus
Vcm cm 0 DC 0.9
V1 IN1 cm DC 0 AC 1 SIN(0 0.1 1MEG)
V2 IN2 cm DC 0 AC -1 SIN(0 -0.1 1MEG)

.control
op
print v(OP) v(OM) v(IN-) v(IN+)

ac dec 20 1k 1G
let out_diff = v(OP) - v(OM)
let in_diff = v(IN1) - v(IN2)
let gain_mag = mag(out_diff) / mag(in_diff)
let gain_db = 20 * log10(gain_mag)
meas ac midband_gain find gain_db at=10k
meas ac bw when gain_db=3.02 fall=1

tran 1n 5u
meas tran op_max max v(OP)
meas tran op_min min v(OP)
let swing = op_max - op_min
print swing
quit
.endc
.end
